items.old: DrawerComponent, BottomSheetComponent, ColorPickerComponent, DatePickerComponent, TimePickerComponent, TextareaComponent, TooltipDirective
items.action: Build after upgrading, and rename or mark `override` every member of yours the compiler reports as colliding.
items.appliesWhen: Only a class of yours that extends one of the listed components. Template users of those components need nothing; subclassing a DS component is unsupported.
items.pitfall: `protected` and `private` are no protection: a redeclared member collides exactly as a public one does.
items.verify: The app builds with no TS4114 or TS2416 against a DS base class.
items.note: DrawerComponent, BottomSheetComponent, ColorPickerComponent and TimePickerComponent gained preview; DatePickerComponent gained preview and selectedAnchorDate; TextareaComponent gained countTrimmed and countedRange; TooltipDirective gained dsTooltipTextSelector, hostElement, isClipped, onKeydown and textElement. The compiler names every collision.

items.action: None, unless you set --ds-tab-label-color-hover or relied on the arrow hover look: set --ds-tabs-scroll-arrow-icon-color-hover and --ds-tabs-scroll-arrow-bg-color-hover on ds-tabs instead.
items.appliesWhen: Only a ds-tabs with scrollable, and only its prev/next arrows on hover. Tab labels still read --ds-tab-label-color-hover.
items.pitfall: An override of --ds-tab-label-color-hover still applies to the tabs, so the arrows quietly change colour while the override looks intact.
items.verify: Hover the next arrow of a scrollable ds-tabs and confirm the chevron's computed colour equals the active tab label's and its surface is --surface-secondary, or your override.

informational.text: The over-limit highlight of a ds-textarea with maxLengthMode="soft" reads the new semantic role --error-highlight (--red-300 in light, hsl(0deg 38% 40%) in dark) instead of --error-muted-strong. An override of --error-muted-strong no longer changes the highlight; set --error-highlight instead.
informational.verify: Type past maxLength in a soft-limit ds-textarea and confirm the computed background-color of the over-limit mark equals --error-highlight in both themes, and the text over it keeps its colour.

informational.text: A dsTooltipWhenClipped host that takes focus itself opens its tip only on keyboard focus, not on a mouse click, and closes it on any key. A dsTooltipWhenClipped host that cannot take focus opens on Tab only when its nearest focusable ancestor is a control: a native a[href], button, input, select, textarea or summary, a table row, or an element with the role button, link, tab, option, menuitem, menuitemcheckbox, menuitemradio, row, gridcell, combobox, checkbox, radio, switch or treeitem. A focusable container such as a ds-tabs panel, a scroll region or a role-less div with tabindex="0" opens nothing. A role-less focusable element that acts as a control discloses again once it carries its role.
informational.verify: Tab onto a ds-tabs panel holding a clipped dsTooltipWhenClipped label and confirm no tooltip opens; Tab onto a ds-button or ds-select trigger holding a clipped label and confirm its tooltip opens, and that a mouse click on it opens none.

informational.text: The ds-table scroll box is position: relative, so the hidden header label of a column with screenReaderLabel and no label is clipped with the rows and no longer widens the page when the table overflows its container. An element positioned absolutely inside a cell template with no positioned ancestor of its own resolves against that scroll box.
informational.verify: At a viewport narrower than the table, put a column with screenReaderLabel and no label past the container's edge and confirm document.documentElement.scrollWidth equals clientWidth while the table still scrolls horizontally inside its box.

informational.text: The ds-tabs scrollable arrows are padded like a tab, so each chevron sits on the tab label line under any --ds-tab-padding-top / --ds-tab-padding-bottom / --ds-tab-indicator-width values, and the hover surface is centred on that line inside the strip. With the default padding nothing moves. In the pills variant the hover surface matches the pill's height and radius.
informational.verify: On a scrollable ds-tabs whose --ds-tab-padding-bottom exceeds --ds-tab-padding-top, confirm the next arrow's chevron and a tab label share a vertical centre within 1px, and that hovering the arrow shows a surface centred on that line.
